display.purpose: The selected instance's name on the home hero. Largest text in the app, appears nowhere else at this size.

label.purpose: Nav items, tags/chips, buttons, form labels, tab names — the workhorse style for anything interactive or structural.

body.purpose: News content, setting descriptions, help text — anything meant to be read at length.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: The system's only "this is alive" signal — active instance tile, focused inputs, primary buttons.

shadows.name: neutral-lift
shadows.purpose: Physical elevation for floating chrome (login card, splash frame) — always neutral black, never tinted.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for hover/active/focus state changes across the app.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per screen — play, save, submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.3rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; padding: 1rem 3.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2dd4bf, #7c5cff); color: #0a0a0a; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(124,92,255,0.35); transition: filter 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c5cff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost-style action for non-primary controls (change path, reset, cancel).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; padding: 0.45rem 1rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid #383d46; border-radius: 6px; color: #f0f0f0; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.18s, background 0.18s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #7c5cff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c5cff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Resting-state tag: hero version/loader tags, playtime badge, account role.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8f98a0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid #383d46; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem; }

components.name: Chip — Active
components.description: Selected-state chip (active theme, active close-behavior) — same gradient-fill language as the primary button.
components.css: .ds-chip-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #0a0a0a; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2dd4bf, #7c5cff); border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; }

components.name: Instance Tile
components.description: Signature component: the XMB-style instance-rail tile, replacing the old instance-selector popup.
components.css: .ds-instance-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-instance-tile__art { width: 76px; height: 76px; border-radius: 10px; background-color: #1a1d23; background-size: cover; background-position: center; border: 2px solid transparent; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-instance-tile:hover .ds-instance-tile__art { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: #383d46; } .ds-instance-tile--active .ds-instance-tile__art { border-color: #7c5cff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124,92,255,0.35), 0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.04); } .ds-instance-tile__label { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #5c6270; max-width: 84px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-instance-tile--active .ds-instance-tile__label, .ds-instance-tile:hover .ds-instance-tile__label { color: #f0f0f0; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Top nav link, resting and active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; } .ds-nav-item { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8f98a0; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.18s, background 0.18s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #f0f0f0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-nav-item--active { color: #f0f0f0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #7c5cff; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Settings section card / news block — flat surface, no shadow.
components.html:
RESOLUCIÓN
Resolución de la ventana de Minecraft. Por defecto: 854 × 480.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #121418; border: 1px solid #262a31; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; max-width: 420px; } .ds-card__title { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.25em; color: #5c6270; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-card__body { font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 300; color: rgba(240,240,240,0.55); line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Account Chip
components.description: Header identity control: avatar + name + auth provider, opens Settings › Account.
components.css: .ds-account-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.9rem 0.3rem 0.3rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid #262a31; cursor: pointer; } .ds-account-chip__avatar { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #383d46; background-color: #1a1d23; } .ds-account-chip__text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-account-chip__name { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #f0f0f0; } .ds-account-chip__role { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5c6270; }

narrative.overview:
MetalDaze Launcher reads like the command deck of a game console, not a settings app with a launch button bolted on. The whole system is near-black and quiet at rest — surfaces, borders, and text sit in tight steps of dark gray so nothing competes for attention — until the one thing that matters lights up: the reactor-teal-to-ion-violet gradient marks the primary action or the thing currently selected, and nothing else. This is a redesign that replaced a prior sidebar-and-list layout (Selvania/Steam-library-style) with a horizontal, always-visible instance rail inspired directly by PS3's XMB menu and modern launchers like Deepslate and Twooverse: pick your modpack from a row of tiles, see it take over the whole screen as a hero background, and hit play.

Precision matters more than decoration here. Every interactive surface is flat by default; the gradient and its glow exist only as a response — hover, active selection, the primary action — never as ambient texture. The launcher's job is to get a player from "I opened this" to "I'm playing the right modpack" in as few visual decisions as possible, and the command-deck framing supports that: one accent, one clear focal point, everything else recedes.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black, flat-by-default dark surfaces (light theme mirrors the same structure, inverted)
A single two-stop gradient accent (teal → violet), reserved for primary actions and active/selected state
Barlow Condensed for all display/label text (often uppercase, wide letter-spacing); Barlow for body copy
A horizontal, XMB-style instance rail is the system's signature interaction, not a generic list or grid
Full-bleed panels are pinned to the real viewport (position: fixed), never left to resolve through ambiguous percentage-height ancestors

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: The teal→violet gradient appears on at most one or two elements per screen — the primary action and the thing currently selected. It is never used as a background wash, a decorative border, or repeated across multiple simultaneous elements. Its rarity is what makes it read as "the one thing to notice."

rules.name: The Light Theme Is Structural, Not Improvised Rule
rules.body: The light theme (.light on <body>) mirrors every dark-theme token 1:1 (bg/surface/surface-2/border/border-lit/text/text-muted/text-dim) with lightness inverted; the accent gradient and status colors stay identical in both themes. Never hand-tune a light-theme color independent of this mapping.

rules.name: The Condensed-for-Structure Rule
rules.body: If text labels an interactive element, a section, or a piece of chrome, it's Barlow Condensed. If it's prose meant to be read, it's Barlow. The two fonts are never swapped for decorative reasons.

rules.name: The Viewport-Pinned Rule
rules.body: Any panel meant to fill the remaining window height below a fixed header must be pinned directly to the viewport (position: fixed with explicit top/left/right/bottom), never given height: calc(100% - Npx) inside a normal-flow ancestor chain. Percentage heights silently break when any ancestor in that chain doesn't have an explicit, non-auto height — the home hero was cut off at the bottom window edge from exactly this mistake.

rules.name: The Overflow-Needs-Room Rule
rules.body: Any element that lifts, scales, or glows on hover/active state must have its scrollable/clipped container padded generously on every side that transform can reach. The instance rail's active tile (lift + scale + glow ring) was visibly clipped at the top and left edge until the rail got explicit padding to match.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth communicates state (selected, focused, primary), not hierarchy. If an element needs to look "raised" at rest with no state to justify it, that's a sign it shouldn't be raised at all — use a lighter surface step instead.

dos: Do keep the accent gradient to one or two elements per screen (The Rare Accent Rule).
Do pin any full-height panel to the real viewport with position: fixed rather than a percentage-height chain (The Viewport-Pinned Rule).
Do pad any container that clips overflow generously enough for its children's hover/active transforms and glows (The Overflow-Needs-Room Rule).
Do keep the Luuxis/Selvania Launcher credit visible in About/README/license — a durable brand commitment, never cosmetic.
Do derive instance-tile art from the instance's own background field (crop to square) rather than requesting a new dedicated icon asset, until the backend adds one.
donts: Don't cover the native window frame controls (minimize/maximize/close) with new full-width fixed chrome — always check z-index and reserve the top-right ~110px.
Don't reintroduce a modal/popup for instance switching — the always-visible rail is the committed interaction model.

Don't use literal photographic or meme placeholder imagery for brand assets (icon, backgrounds) — until real MetalDaze Estudio art lands, placeholders stay abstract gradient-based art in the same accent family.
Don't give a static, non-interactive surface a shadow to fake hierarchy — use a lighter surface step instead (The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule).
